PRIYA RAGHAVAN
London | priya.raghavan@example.com

SUMMARY
Product leader with 11 years building payments and marketplace products.
Currently Senior Product Manager at Meridian Pay.

EXPERIENCE

Meridian Pay — Senior Product Manager (2019 - present)
- Owned the merchant payouts platform processing GBP 4.2bn annually.
- Led the migration from a single-processor setup to a multi-acquirer routing
  layer, cutting payment failure rates by 38% and saving GBP 2.1m annually in
  interchange.
- Set the three-year platform strategy; presented it to the board twice.
- Ran the response to a 2022 outage that stopped payouts for six hours.
- Managed a team of fourteen engineers alongside two designers.
- Mentored three PMs, two of whom were promoted.

Kestrel Commerce — Product Manager (2016 - 2019)
- Built the marketplace split-payments product from zero to 900 merchants.
- Ran 40+ A/B tests on checkout; improved conversion by 12%.
- Worked with compliance on PSD2 readiness ahead of the 2019 deadline.

Tavistock Group — Associate Product Manager (2014 - 2016)
- Supported the core billing product.
